title: Reinforcement learning in financial markets - a survey
source: FAU Discussion Papers in Economics, No. 12/2018, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg
summary: This survey examines the application of reinforcement learning (RL) to financial markets, reviewing nearly 50 publications and categorizing approaches into three main types: critic-only, actor-only, and actor-critic methods. The paper highlights how RL overcomes limitations of supervised learning by integrating prediction and portfolio construction into a single optimized step while incorporating real-world constraints such as transaction costs and market liquidity.
